item.title: Weaviate Releases Idiomatic Go Client Library
item.description:
Weaviate Releases Idiomatic Go Client Library

Weaviate has published an idiomatic Go client library for interacting with its vector database platform.

🔍 Overview

  • The Go client provides a native interface for Weaviate’s core features and APIs
  • Example code is available demonstrating key functionality
  • Full documentation covers usage patterns and integration details

📚 Resources

  • Examples: Located in the example directory showing core features and API usage
  • Documentation: Available at docs.weaviate.io covering Weaviate concepts and Go client specifics

#Weaviate #Go #VectorDatabase #ClientLibrary

Source: weaviate/weaviate-go-client
